items.title: Kroger Is Buying Another Grocery Chain While Still in Court Over the Last One
items.summary: Kroger just announced a $1.65 billion grocery acquisition while still fighting its last merger partner in court over the exact same regulatory strategy it plans to use again. The word at the center of both stories is the same, and that is not a coincidence.

items.title: Kroger (KR) Taps Mark Ibbotson To Help Drive Its Store And Digital Shift
items.summary: Kroger (NYSE:KR) has appointed Mark Ibbotson as Executive Vice President and Chief Store Operations Officer. Ibbotson brings extensive experience leading digital transformation and omnichannel operations at Walmart and Asda. The appointment is intended to support Kroger's store operations and omnichannel execution across grocery and pharmacy delivery. items.title: Kroger (KR) Stock Looks Fair On Earnings While Returns Stay Strong
items.summary: Kroger stock has delivered a solid gain over the past five years, yet the current checks on valuation paint more of a middle of the road picture rather than a clear bargain or a clear stretch price. Recent returns have softened, so the key issue is whether the current share price still fairly reflects Kroger’s role in mainstream grocery and its push into digital ordering and pharmacy services.
